title: Add a calculated column
summary: A new column can come from a calculation on an existing one. Matching rows keep their relationship.
introduction: A new column can come from a calculation on an existing one. Matching rows keep their relationship. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A new column can come from a calculation on an existing one. Matching rows keep their relationship.

blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Asha", "Ben", "Cara"],
    "score": [8, 6, 9],
    "team": ["red", "blue", "red"]
})

df["bonus_score"] = df["score"] + 1
print(df["bonus_score"].tolist())
blocks.title: Add a calculated column

blocks.text: The output is [9, 7, 10]. One point is added to each row's score.

blocks.text: Keep the original column when you still need the unmodified data.
